recentItems.title: The real reason women aren't dating | Engagement Party
recentItems.description:
The internet is full of dating horror stories and think pieces the death of traditional romance. It’s a concept built for virality. But is the moral panic real? Audie and Ari turn to relationship writer Karley Sciortino to talk navigating romance in the age of the apps.

0:00 Is the romance recession real? 
2:24 The 20-somethings we work with weigh in on the dismal state of dating
3:14 Heteropessimism is showing up in our movies and TV, too
5:52 Audie and Ari disclose their own limitations (they're off the market)
7:20 The generational divide the apps have created in romance
9:45 It used to be a lot of work to play the field, but now it's easy to have a "roster"
10:49 Maybe the cure for straight romance is to take notes from queer people
13:00 Karley Sciortino is the 21st century Carrie Bradshaw and she's here to help
15:23 The apps were sold to us as efficiency, but romance needs friction
17:06 The alternatives to the apps involve (shocker) going outside 
21:40 Women's expectations for relationships have shifted, but why is that a bad thing? 
26:40 Scroll & Tell: Women are crashing out over men not asking them any questions about themselves
30:36 Take or Tea: ghosting, AI matchmakers, who should pay on dates, marriage sabbaticals 

Something in your feed you want us to talk about on the show? Email us a video at engagementparty@cnn.com and we’ll feature you on the show.

recentItems.title: Two people rescued from hydropower tunnel in Nepal
recentItems.description: Two people have been rescued from a hydropower tunnel in Nepal, a dramatic breakthrough more than a week after catastrophic floods hit the country’s border with China. CNN's Hanako Montgomery reports.

recentItems.title: Fox News abruptly ousts Maria Bartiromo, longtime Trump ally
recentItems.description: Fox News has parted ways with longtime anchor Maria Bartiromo, one of President Donald Trump’s closest allies at the network. CNN’s Brian Stelter reports.

recentItems.title: GOP Mayor rejects Trump renaming Lake Ontario: Its 'part of our identity'
recentItems.description: A Republican mayor who voted for Donald Trump is defying his executive order renaming Lake Ontario to "Lake America." Mayor Robert Corradino of Oswego, New York—a city along the lake's southeastern shore—told CNN's Erin Burnett that the historic body of water is central to his community's "identity." "I don't care if you're Republican, Democrat, Independent," Corradino said. "This means a lot to the residents of Oswego and Oswego County."

recentItems.title: Iran warns Americans to stockpile gas, says 'dark months lie ahead'
recentItems.description:
The conflict with Iran is escalating rapidly after strikes on multiple U.S. bases in the Middle East. Now, Iran has issued an ominous warning directly to the American public: stockpile gas and prepare for 'dark months lie ahead' as energy markets brace for severe disruption. 

CNN's Erin Burnett break's down the latest updates on rising gas prices, the growing fallout over depleted U.S. weapons stockpiles, and the conflicting messages coming from the Trump administration—with Donald Trump declaring a state of war while JD Vance downplays the immediate threat.

recentItems.title: Ex-sailor reveals USS Abe Lincoln's hidden mental health toll
recentItems.description:
CNN's Pamela Brown explores the broader issue of mental health resources available to service members during their deployments, and the long journey for one former enlisted sailor to being medically discharged for mental health reasons.

And Admiral Gary Roughead, Fmr. Chief of US Naval Operations, shares his perspective on the poor living conditions aboard USS Abraham Lincoln.

The aircraft carrier arrived in Thailand on Wednesday, its first regular port call in more than eight months, ending a marathon stint at sea in the Middle East that raised concerns about the welfare of its crew.

The 100,000-ton ship departed San Diego last November, and when it returns to Southern California later this year it will have completed one of the longest deployments in US Navy history.

recentItems.title: Tensions flare in Clancy courtroom
recentItems.description: CNN’s Jean Casarez breaks down the tension in the courtroom as the deadlocked jury in the Lindsay Clancy trial ended its sixth day of deliberations without a verdict. Clancy’s defense claims there is “one juror who refuses to listen to the law.”

recentItems.title: NASCAR’s Kurt Busch tells Anderson Cooper where he still feels his brother Kyle’s presence
recentItems.description:
NASCAR champions and brothers Kurt and Kyle Busch spent decades racing each other before Kyle’s sudden death in May at 41. Kurt talks with Anderson Cooper about their years of “sibling rivalry,” the “brotherhood” they shared on the racetrack and where he feels Kyle’s presence the most.

recentItems.title: Vance’s message to widow of airman killed in Iran war
recentItems.description: Vice President JD Vance told CNN’s Kaitlan Collins that the administration would work to ensure that the widow of an airman killed during the war with Iran receives military benefits, after the widow said in a social media post that she was being denied some funds because the US had not “declared war.”
